name: request
desc: A request note (template pai-request/1) before intake: front matter checks, and the JEV intake questions.

checks.desc: the request section has at least one line of 40+ characters (not the template's hint)

jev.instructions: The note asks for specific changes to code or files in a software repository, and says what the result should be, so a developer could start without asking any questions.
How much reasoning the work needs.

criteria.haiku: Mechanical: rename, typo, formatting, one obvious edit.
criteria.sonnet: Normal feature or bug fix touching a few files, with tests.
criteria.opus: Design decisions, unknown-cause bugs, many modules, security or concurrency.

jev.instructions: This is a large request that should be split into several parallel lanes of work (separate areas of files, each with many items), rather than one task for one developer.
